headline: A 2016 law renamed the VA outpatient clinic in The Dalles, Oregon, as the Loren R. Kaufman VA Clinic.
what_it_does: The law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic at 704 Veterans Drive in The Dalles, Oregon, as the Loren R. Kaufman VA Clinic. It changes only the clinic's name and does not change its services, staffing, or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 22, 2016.
